key_insight: Exact certification reveals that some reported quantum error-correction distances are overstated and identifies circuit schedules that restore stronger protection.
engineering_relevance: Certified distances can guide code selection, circuit scheduling and defective-chip acceptance rather than relying on heuristic upper bounds.
method: Express code and circuit distances as tropical partition functions.
Evaluate them using rank-based dynamic programming and weight-bounded search, aided by reductions and relaxations.
Certify exact distances by matching proved lower bounds with explicit logical errors.
evidence_signal: The method certified codes with up to 31,200 qubits and circuits with up to 800,000 fault mechanisms; an audit found overestimated distances or non-tight upper bounds in 10 of 26 papers.
watch_item: Schedule improvements can add timing overhead: the redesigned IBM two-gross schedule reaches distance 18 at one noisy cycle but requires one additional timestep per cycle.
paper_title: Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale
